$comment: Canonical studio software list shared by Tandava, TeacherTree, ClassStamp and CueCraft. Ids are permanent. detect.domains are hosts seen on real studio booking pages or the vendor's own embed docs; detect.unverified are guesses and are never used for public claims. Listing a vendor is not an endorsement.
